svg.title: NER tag-correction pipeline architecture
svg.text: ground truth · model output · source text
keep only documents where GT and the model
disagree; seeded balanced assignment, r each
Blinding: the two candidates carry neutral positional labels; left/right order is re-randomised for every pair
Flag + comment · Unaligned (keep original) · Skip · Undo
reviewer lists the conflict bundles, then resolves each by
picking one annotator's output or supplying a merged JSON
